admission.justification: Store and shown-chat publication jointly prevent later picks or stale context from silently redirecting the developer’s recipient choice, with focused default tests.

applicability: An empty, unchosen collection receiving its first admitted pick, including the review page’s pending closed-column default.
conditions: A chat passage chooses its source agent; another pick chooses the published shown chat, or none when no chat is published.
Subsequent picks leave the decided target set unchanged, and an explicit single or multiple target choice always wins.
A first review pick with a deferred default waits for the column’s published chat; explicit target selection, last-pick removal or leaving that wait cancels it.
Removing the last pick reopens an automatic default for the next collection, but preserves an explicit target choice.
exclusions: Published document-chat identity is the active nonhidden bound target, not a claim that the native drawn acknowledgement has already arrived.
Chats can publish the plugin’s actual shown-chat report; target selection itself is not host navigation.
No new role or agent is created to choose a recipient.
